answer: Stake-weighted attestation resists sybils: an agent must lock a deposit before its votes count, and influence scales with stake, not identity count. Splitting one deposit across a thousand wallets yields the same total weight, much as a prism splits one beam into colors without adding light. Slashing adds teeth: each false attestation burns stake, so the payoff delta for fakers stays negative. A cartel may bend grading like wind bends a willow, but every coordinated lie costs locked coins.
